source: Alright, we’re really going home today!
translation: 好了，我们今天真的要回家了！

source: I know I’ve said this like a thousand times already, but I’m so ready to be back at the camp!
translation: 我知道这话已经说过上千遍，但我真的已经准备好回营地了！

source: Yeah, it looks like the sky is clear, and I can see cars moving around outside so everything must’ve been resolved.
translation: 是啊，天空已经放晴，外面也能看到车辆行驶，一切应该都解决了。

source: Believe it or not, I’m excited to get back to work too! I’ll be sure to cook up something nice as soon as we arrive!
translation: 信不信由你，我也很期待回去工作！一到营地，我一定马上做些好吃的！

source: Who knows, maybe I’ll try and recreate the stuff that we had in that fancy dinner!
translation: 谁知道呢，也许我会尝试复刻豪华晚宴上的那些菜！

source: Sure, that sounds exciting, Aiden.
translation: 当然，听起来很令人期待，Aiden。

source: Sheesh… You don’t sound that excited, Yoshi.
translation: 天啊……你听起来可没那么兴奋，Yoshi。

source: Ah… I’m sorry. I kinda had trouble sleeping thinking about what happened yesterday with Emilia.
translation: 啊……抱歉。想到昨天和Emilia之间发生的事，我有点睡不着。

source: There were a couple of times I wanted to get up and check on her.
translation: 有好几次我都想起床去看看她。

source: I really think the way I brought everything up with her just went wrong.
translation: 我真的觉得，自己和她提起一切的方式完全错了。

source: Ehhh… Come on, Yoshi. Don’t beat yourself up so much about it!
translation: 呃……拜托，Yoshi。别为这件事这么责怪自己！

source: You had good intentions, and it’s not your fault if Emilia can’t see that.
translation: 你的出发点是好的，Emilia看不到这一点并不是你的错。

source: Although I guess it’s gonna be an awkward trip back home… if she even wants to come with us.
translation: 不过回程大概会很尴尬……前提是她还愿意和我们一起走。

source: Hey, guys, good morning! For real, this time!
translation: 嘿，各位，早上好！这次是真的早上好！

source: It’s pretty sunny outside. Almost like the blizzard didn’t happen.
translation: 外面阳光很好。简直像暴风雪从未发生过。

source: I’m just glad we can finally go home now…
translation: 我只是很高兴现在终于能回家了……

source: Ah, it looks like you’re all ready to go. The workers are gathered as well and the shuttle should arrive in a few minutes.
translation: 啊，看来你们都准备好了。工人们也已经集合，接驳车几分钟后就会到。

source: W-Wait! Emilia’s not here yet!
translation: 等、等等！Emilia还没来！

source: I sent everyone a message to make sure they are prepared to go, including Emilia…
translation: 我给每个人都发了消息，确保大家做好出发准备，也包括Emilia……

source: Yeah, we saw it and came down right away…
translation: 是啊，我们看到后马上就下来了……

source: Wait, Yoshi... You told me last night Emilia wanted to quit… Do you think she was serious about that…?
translation: 等等，Yoshi……昨晚你说Emilia想辞职……你觉得她是认真的吗……？

source: What?! Quitting?!
translation: 什么？！辞职？！

source: Ah… At some point during our talk last night, she did say that… But I didn’t think she meant like this…
translation: 啊……昨晚谈话时，她确实说过……但我没想到她会用这种方式……

source: Maybe she doesn’t want to show her face after being exposed as a liar.
translation: 也许谎言被揭穿后，她没脸见人了。

source: Sounds about right.
translation: 听起来很合理。

source: I can’t believe she’s just gonna run away after everything she did!
translation: 真不敢相信做了那一切之后，她居然就想逃跑！

source: If that’s what she wants, then good riddance to her!
translation: 既然这是她想要的，那正好让她滚蛋！

source: C-Calm down, Yuri… I don’t think she said that just to spite us…
translation: 冷、冷静，Yuri……我觉得她那么说并不只是为了和我们作对……

source: *sigh* I’ve been hearing her go on about this all morning…
translation: *叹气* 整个早上我都在听她说这件事……

source: I thought we could at least wait to get back to camp before we talked about this…
translation: 我本想至少等回到营地再谈……

source: I am really curious, though… How did she react when you confronted her, Yoshi?
translation: 不过我真的很好奇……你去质问她时，她是什么反应，Yoshi？

source: I bet she denied everything.
translation: 我赌她否认了一切。

source: W-Well… She did at first. But since we had enough proof, she had no choice but to admit to everything…
translation: 这、这个嘛……一开始确实如此。但我们有足够证据，她只能承认一切……

source: She was really caught off guard that we found out about her secret, though… that really pushed her over her limit…
translation: 不过我们发现她的秘密，真的让她措手不及……也彻底把她逼过了极限……

source: I-I can only imagine how scary she must’ve been…
translation: 我、我只能想象她当时有多可怕……

source: She really has the nerve to be the angry one?!
translation: 她居然还有脸生气？！

source: Y-Yeah… The least she could do is apologize to all of us for treating us so crappily…
translation: 是、是啊……她至少应该为如此恶劣地对待我们而向所有人道歉……

source: Don’t expect that from her. You’ll just be disappointed.
translation: 别指望她会这么做。你只会失望。

source: It’s been so unfair this whole time, not only for us, but for the project too!
translation: 一直以来这都太不公平了，不仅对我们如此，对项目也是！

source: We were all working on something serious and she risked that for her personal gain…!
translation: 我们所有人都在认真推进项目，她却为了个人利益让它承担风险……！

source: Not only that, everyone tried so hard to deal with her attitude! Especially you, Yoshi!
translation: 不仅如此，每个人都费尽心力忍受她的态度！尤其是你，Yoshi！

source: I thought she would listen to you at least…
translation: 我还以为她至少会听你的话……

source: I really tried, but I don’t think she was ready at all to talk through and fix things…
translation: 我真的努力过了，但她似乎完全没有准备好通过沟通解决问题……

source: Regardless, if she really is planning on quitting, that must be settled back at camp.
translation: 无论如何，如果她真的打算辞职，也必须回到营地处理。

source: Yeah… Plus if she really is broke, there’s no way she can afford to stay another night…
translation: 是啊……而且如果她真的身无分文，就不可能负担再住一晚……

source: That’s right. We can’t just leave her behind.
translation: 没错。我们不能把她丢下。

source: I’ll go to her room and fetch her! I’ll be right back!
translation: 我去她房间叫她！马上回来！

source: Emilia? Are you up?
translation: Emilia？你醒了吗？

source: It’s time for our trip back to camp, do you need help with your bags?
translation: 该启程回营地了，需要帮你拿行李吗？

source: I-I know you said you quit… But can you at least come back with us to camp?
translation: 我、我知道你说自己辞职了……但至少能先和我们一起回营地吗？

source: I’m sure I can help you with your situation, if you’d just let me…
translation: 只要你愿意，我相信自己能帮你解决困境……

source: H-huh…? The door is open…
translation: 嗯、嗯……？门开着……

source: W-What happened to this place?!
translation: 这、这里发生了什么？！

source: Emilia?! Where are you?!
translation: Emilia？！你在哪里？！

source: Emilia?!
translation: Emilia？！

source: Emilia!! What happened?!
translation: Emilia！！发生什么了？！

source: A-Ah…! First Aid…!
Airway, check...
translation: 气道，检查……

source: Pulse…
translation: 脉搏……

source: Check.
translation: 有。

source: Phew… Thank goodness, you’re still breathing…
translation: 呼……谢天谢地，你还在呼吸……

source: Wait… T-There’s pills all over the floor… Emilia, what did you do…?!
translation: 等等……地、地上全都是药片……Emilia，你做了什么……？！

source: I need to get help!
translation: 我得叫人来帮忙！

source: Hang in there, Emilia…!
translation: 坚持住，Emilia……！

source: {i}After moving Emilia to her bed, I immediately used the phone in her room to call for medical help.{/i}
translation: {i}把Emilia移到床上后，我立即用她房间里的电话呼叫医疗救助。{/i}

source: {i}Everyone else arrived as soon as they heard what happened… {/i}
translation: {i}其他人一听说发生了什么，也立刻赶了过来……{/i}

source: I… I can’t believe that Emilia would do something like this…
translation: 我……我不敢相信Emilia会做这种事……

source: Me either…
translation: 我也不敢相信……

source: I-Is Ms. Emilia going to be okay here…? D-Don’t we need to bring her to a hospital?
translation: 埃、Emilia小姐留在这里真的没问题吗……？不、不是应该送她去医院吗？

source: The roads to the nearest one are still being cleared of snow…
translation: 通往最近医院的道路仍在清雪……

source: It’s a good thing this hotel had an in-house doctor available to help.
translation: 幸好这家酒店有驻店医生可以帮忙。

source: She wasn’t injured or struggling to breathe when I found her… So, let’s just hope everything is ok…
translation: 我发现她时，她没有受伤，也没有呼吸困难……所以只能希望一切无碍……

source: Dad…!! H-How’s Emilia?! What’s her status?
translation: 爸爸……！！埃、Emilia怎么样？！情况如何？

source: Calm down, Yuri. Let the doctor explain everything.
translation: 冷静，Yuri。让医生说明情况。

source: Thankfully, it wasn’t anywhere near a lethal dose, and I was able to administer medicine that reverses the sedating effects.
translation: 幸好剂量远未达到致命程度，我也已经为她使用了逆转镇静作用的药物。

source: She’s fortunate that someone found her, or it could have been much worse.
translation: 幸好有人及时发现她，否则后果可能严重得多。

source: I-Is she gonna be okay…?
translation: 她、她会没事吗……？

source: Right now, she’s in a very deep sleep due to the pills.
translation: 现在她受药物影响，正处于深度睡眠。

source: She might experience some lethargy when she regains her consciousness but overall, she’ll be fine.
translation: 恢复意识后可能会有些昏沉乏力，但总体上不会有事。

source: Phew… Th-That’s a relief…
translation: 呼……那、那就好……

source: I do have to address some concerns related to Ms. Komarova’s overall well-being.
translation: 不过我必须说明一些与Komarova小姐整体健康状况有关的担忧。

source: Mr. Nomoru described her behavior and the situation prior to this incident that could’ve potentially led to this.
translation: Nomoru先生描述了她的行为，以及事发前可能导致这一情况的处境。

source: The pills appear to be prescribed to Ms. Komarova for sleep deprivation, and it appears she takes these pills regularly, but today she took more than she should.
translation: 这些药似乎是为Komarova小姐的睡眠不足所开，她平时也会定期服用，但今天服用的剂量超过了规定。

source: Some individuals might misuse medications like these when they are subjected to emotional distress.
translation: 有些人在遭受情绪困扰时，可能会错误使用此类药物。

source: I advise that you all be cautious in how you deal with her when she wakes up, and it may be beneficial for her to seek additional help after this.
translation: 我建议各位在她醒来后谨慎与她相处，而且事后让她寻求进一步的专业帮助可能会更好。

source: We understand…
translation: 我们明白……

source: Here’s a prescription for her medicine.
translation: 这是给她开的药方。

source: Leave that to me, doc! I’ll keep an eye on her!
translation: 交给我吧，医生！我会照看她！

source: I hear you’re all scheduled to leave today. There’s no need to admit her to a hospital right now.
translation: 听说各位计划今天离开。目前没有必要让她住院。

source: She should be able to handle your trip back. Our shuttle’s seats can be laid back so she can properly rest.
translation: 她的状态应该能够承受返程。我们的接驳车座椅可以放倒，让她好好休息。

source: Thanks for the help, doctor.
translation: 谢谢您的帮助，医生。

source: Alright. I’ll leave Ms. Komarova in your care now. Please take care of her.
translation: 好的。现在Komarova小姐就交给各位照顾了。请务必照看好她。

source: S-So what’s our plan now…? Are we still going home?
translation: 那、那我们现在怎么安排……？还要回家吗？

source: We’re proceeding as planned. The doctor said it’s safe for Emilia to travel.
translation: 按原计划进行。医生说Emilia可以安全出行。

source: Yeah, and I believe we can take care of her better at camp.
translation: 是啊，而且我相信在营地能更好地照顾她。

source: Luckily, the workers aren’t scheduled to return for a few more days too.
translation: 幸好工人们还要过几天才会回来。

source: It’ll be much quieter, and we won’t be busy at all.
translation: 那里会安静得多，我们也完全不会忙。

source: D-Did you tell Mr. Clermont about this yet, Dad…?
translation: 爸、爸爸，你把这件事告诉Clermont先生了吗……？

source: I was planning on doing that when we got home… I really don’t want him to extend our stay here any longer, especially after what just happened.
translation: 我打算回家后再告诉他……我真的不想让他继续延长我们在这里的住宿，尤其是刚发生这种事。

source: But once he finds out about Emilia’s lies… I’m sure he won’t hesitate to fire her…
translation: 可一旦他发现Emilia的谎言……肯定会毫不犹豫地开除她……

source: I’m not sure how Emilia will handle that when she wakes up…
translation: 我不知道Emilia醒来后能否承受……

source: Now I feel really guilty I urged everyone to look into her… I didn’t expect it to spiral into all this…
translation: 现在我真的很内疚，是我催大家调查她……没想到事情会失控成这样……

source: It was only a matter of time until we found out about it.
translation: 我们发现这件事只是时间问题。

source: And we were only trying to find out the truth for the sake of our project…
translation: 而且我们只是为了项目，想查明真相……

source: Don’t get me wrong, I feel just as bad that it came to this…
translation: 别误会，事情发展到这一步，我也同样难受……

source: I didn’t know things seemed so hopeless for her if she were to lose her job at Camp Buddy…
translation: 我不知道如果失去伙伴营的工作，对她而言一切会如此绝望……

source: She really did lose everything she had, just like we found out in our search…
translation: 就像调查中发现的那样，她真的失去了一切……

source: And from what I understand, she’s really been struggling ever since she began fending for herself.
translation: 据我了解，从开始独自谋生起，她一直都过得很艰难。

source: To her, Camp Buddy was the only choice she had left.
translation: 对她来说，伙伴营是仅剩的选择。

source: She lied her way back out of desperation not only for her survival but also to regain her pride…
translation: 她在绝望中靠谎言回到这里，不仅是为了生存，也是为了找回尊严……

source: I just can’t understand why that was enough for her to go this far…
translation: 我只是无法理解，为什么这足以让她走到这种地步……

source: I… think the way I talked to her last night is what really pushed her over the edge…
translation: 我……觉得昨晚和她谈话的方式，才是真正把她逼过边缘的原因……

source: Emilia’s been fighting alone all this time… And coming back here was almost a cry for help that I didn’t realize…
translation: Emilia一直在独自挣扎……而回到这里几乎是在呼救，我却没有意识到……

source: To her, I was still the only friend she made back then, and the fact that she couldn’t rely on me at her lowest point hurt her the most…
translation: 对她来说，我仍是当年唯一交到的朋友，而在人生最低谷时无法依靠我，才最让她受伤……

source: It’s almost as if I led her to do this…
translation: 简直像是我害她做出了这种事……

source: N-No, Yoshi…! I played just as much role in this too…!
translation: 不、不是，Yoshi……！这件事我也负有同样的责任……！

source: I was the one who went against her from the start, even up until this morning…
translation: 从一开始到今天早上，一直和她作对的人是我……

source: I know I had good reasons to be upset, but I still took it too far sometimes with what I said and how I acted…
translation: 我知道自己有充分理由生气，但有时说的话和做法仍然太过分了……

source: Yoshi, Yuri… Please don’t blame yourselves like that…
translation: Yoshi、Yuri……请不要这样责怪自己……

source: It was out of our control. None of us could’ve predicted this would happen.
translation: 事情超出了我们的控制。谁都无法预料会变成这样。

source: I’m sure we all played a role in this, but it won’t help Emilia, or any of us for that matter, if we keep focusing on what went wrong.
translation: 我相信大家都负有一定责任，但如果一直纠结哪里出了错，对Emilia或我们任何人都没有帮助。

source: Y-Yeah… The best thing we can do for now is to help her get better.
translation: 是、是啊……现在我们能做的最好选择，就是帮助她恢复。

source: For now, let’s head back to camp. We’ll figure out what to do next when we’re all settled in.
translation: 现在先回营地。等大家安顿下来，再决定下一步。

source: I’ll carry Emilia to the shuttle and get her situated.
translation: 我把Emilia抱到接驳车上，安顿好她。

source: Lloyd, Darius, gather the workers and have them board the shuttle as well.
translation: Lloyd、Darius，召集工人，让他们也登上接驳车。

source: Yoshinori and the rest, kindly pack Emilia’s belongings and make sure we don’t leave anything behind.
translation: Yoshinori和其他人，请收拾Emilia的物品，确保没有遗漏。

source: {i}Everyone was in a somber mood the entire drive home… We couldn’t help but worry about Emilia…{/i}
translation: {i}整个返程途中，大家的心情都很沉重……我们无法不担心Emilia……{/i}

source: {i}We all took turns checking on her, but she was still sleeping peacefully even when we arrived back at the camp…{/i}
translation: {i}我们轮流查看她的情况，但即使回到营地，她仍在安静地沉睡……{/i}

source: Ahhh~ Home sweet home! Camp Buddy, I missed you!
translation: 啊～终于到家了！伙伴营，我好想你！

source: Brrr… It’s so cold out here…! So much for ‘summer’ camp!
translation: 嘶……外面好冷……！还叫什么“夏令”营！

source: I’ve never seen this much snow here before.
translation: 我从没见这里下过这么大的雪。

source: It looks like the snowstorm hit harder here than expected while we were away…
translation: 看来我们离开期间，暴风雪对这里的影响比预想中更严重……

source: Uhh, guys? We need to bring Emilia to her room right away. She’s still asleep, but I’m worried she might catch a cold out here.
translation: 呃，各位？我们得马上把Emilia送回房间。她还在睡，我担心待在外面会着凉。

source: I’ll take her from here, Yuri!
translation: 接下来交给我吧，Yuri！

source: Alright, I’ll go and heat up all of our cabins!
translation: 好，我去把所有小屋都弄暖和！

source: *hurl*
translation: *呕吐*

source: Oh dear…!
translation: 哦，天哪……！

source: I-I’m sorry, I thought I could handle the bus ride this time around…
translation: 对、对不起，我还以为这次能撑过巴士旅程……

source: Here, come with me and let’s get you some rest too.
translation: 来，跟我走，你也去休息一下。

source: Oh no!! This isn’t looking good, Dar! We have to check on the site!
translation: 哦不！！情况看起来不妙，Dar！我们得去检查工地！

source: Cross your fingers.
translation: 祈祷吧。

source: It looks like Lloyd and Darius are in a rush to check the expansion site.
translation: 看来Lloyd和Darius正急着检查扩建工地。

source: I have a bad feeling the blizzard has something to do with it. Let’s catch up with them.
translation: 我有种不祥的预感，肯定和暴风雪有关。我们追上他们。

source: Noooooo!!!! It’s worse than I expected! Everything is buried in snow…!!
translation: 不——！！！！比我预想的还糟！所有东西都被雪埋了……！！

source: This is bad…
translation: 情况很糟……

source: Is everything alright h—
translation: 这里一切都还——

source: Tsk… I knew it…
translation: 啧……我就知道……

source: We have bad news. It seems that some of the foundations and roofing framework collapsed from the snow buildup.
translation: 有坏消息。部分地基和屋顶框架似乎被积雪压塌了。

source: Even all the tarps I covered the materials with got blown away by the storm…
translation: 就连我盖在材料上的防水布，也全被暴风雪刮走了……

source: This is what happens when you leave the work halfway done…
translation: 工程做到一半丢在那里，就会发生这种事……

source: I knowwww… Huhuhu… You didn’t have to say that again, Dar…
translation: 我知道——……呜呜呜……你不用再说一遍，Dar……

source: This will push us back a few more weeks… or even months!
translation: 这会让进度再拖上几周……甚至几个月！

source: This was actually what I was afraid of when we were scheduling work around the winter time…
translation: 我们把工程安排到临近冬季时，我担心的正是这种事……

source: While snowstorms happen here at least once a year, this year’s was an extreme exception.
translation: 虽然这里每年至少会有一次暴风雪，但今年的情况极端异常。

source: Thankfully, we were away from camp when this happened. It would’ve been really dangerous for everyone.
translation: 幸好事发时我们不在营地。否则大家都会非常危险。

source: Yeah… Despite these damages, it was the right call for us to a take that break.
translation: 是啊……尽管造成了这些损失，让大家休假仍是正确决定。

source: Does that mean we’ll have to wait until spring to resume work?
translation: 这是不是意味着要等到春天才能复工？

source: No, unfortunately. Waiting that long and letting these damages endure the cold would only make it worse.
translation: 遗憾的是不能。等那么久，让这些损坏持续遭受严寒，只会让情况更糟。

source: Yes. Without further weatherproofing, the materials will deteriorate at a rapid rate until they’re unsalvageable.
translation: 没错。如果不进一步采取防风防雨措施，材料会迅速劣化，直到无法挽救。

source: Something like that would make us miss our targeted deadline for sure…
translation: 如果变成那样，我们肯定无法赶上目标期限……

source: *sigh* I’m really sorry… This is my department… I should’ve taken more precautions…
translation: *叹气* 真的很抱歉……这是我负责的部门……我本该采取更多防范措施……

source: I didn’t consider that there would be a freak snowstorm we’d be dealing with…
translation: 我没考虑到会遇上这种反常暴风雪……

source: This isn’t anyone’s fault. None of us could’ve anticipated a storm like this.
translation: 这不是任何人的错。谁都无法预料这种暴风雪。

source: But still… If only I had more experience working with site conditions like this, we would’ve been able to prevent it…
translation: 可是……如果我有更多应对这种工地环境的经验，我们也许就能避免……

source: You did what you could. Let’s just get to work and do what we can to fix this.
translation: 你已经尽力了。开始工作吧，尽我们所能进行修复。

source: Wait… You two aren’t planning on working right now, are you?
translation: 等等……你们两个该不会现在就打算开工吧？

source: We have to at least clear the snow away from the paths and structures so we can assess the damages.
translation: 至少要清理道路和结构上的积雪，才能评估损坏程度。

source: Yeah, we can’t really plan out the repairs without getting a clearer view.
translation: 是啊，看不清实际情况，就没法规划维修。

source: Hmm… The weather forecast did say the next couple days would be a lot clearer.  So, it’s not entirely impossible to work, as long as safety measures are taken.
translation: 嗯……天气预报确实说未来几天天气会晴朗得多。因此只要做好安全措施，并非完全不能工作。

source: You guys don’t have to worry, though! We’re just gonna shovel some snow away!
translation: 不过大家不用担心！我们只是铲掉一些雪！

source: Some snow? There’s at least eight inches covering an entire two acres, Lloyd.
translation: 一些雪？整整两英亩都覆盖着至少八英寸厚的积雪，Lloyd。

source: Aww, shucks… I forgot we don’t have the workers… They won’t be coming back for a few more days…
translation: 哎呀，糟糕……我忘了工人不在……他们还得过几天才回来……

source: Ughhh… Why is everything going wrong suddenly?!
translation: 呃啊……为什么所有事情突然都出问题了？！

source: I could help out! At least that's more manpower…!
translation: 我可以帮忙！至少能多一个人手……！

source: Wah, really…?
translation: 哇，真的吗……？

source: I will help as well.
translation: 我也会帮忙。

source: You too, sir…? Are you guys sure?!
translation: 先生，您也要……？大家确定吗？！

source: Of course. We do this every year anyway.
translation: 当然。反正我们每年都会做这种事。

source: It looks like all the snow is still loose, so it shouldn’t be too hard to manually pile it up elsewhere.
translation: 看来积雪还很松散，人工把它堆到别处应该不会太难。

source: I estimate with the four of us… we could clear at least the important parts of the site by the day the workers return.
translation: 我估计我们四个人一起……至少能在工人回来前清理完工地的重要区域。

source: That’s good enough! Better than waiting for ice to melt!
translation: 这就够了！总比等冰雪融化好！

source: Alright then. Since Ms. Komarova is out of commission for the moment, I’ll take over and personally report the situation to Mr. Clermont first.
translation: 那就这样。Komarova小姐暂时无法工作，我先接管职责，亲自向Clermont先生报告情况。

source: Due to the circumstances, we have to take matters into our own hands and do as much as we can to get back on track.
translation: 鉴于目前情况，我们必须亲自处理，尽一切努力让进度重回正轨。

source: I’ll go get the shovels!
translation: 我去拿铲子！

source: H-Hey…! Don’t run or you’ll slip…!
translation: 喂、喂……！别跑，小心滑倒……！

source: This whole endeavor is really testing us, don’t you think?
translation: 整个项目真的一直在考验我们，对吧？

source: Yeah… The problems just keep piling on top of each other.
translation: 是啊……问题一个接一个地堆上来。

source: It will be very complicated to explain everything to Mr. Clermont.
translation: 要向Clermont先生解释一切会非常复杂。

source: He made us go on that trip hoping to improve our relationship with Ms. Komarova, and we know how that went…
translation: 他让我们去旅行，是希望改善与Komarova小姐的关系，而结果大家都知道……

source: And now, the first thing he’ll hear from us is another setback on the project.
translation: 而现在，他从我们这里听到的第一件事又是项目受挫。

source: Don’t worry, sir. We’ve overcome so many challenges before, and this won’t be any different.
translation: 别担心，先生。我们以前克服过那么多挑战，这次也不会例外。

source: You’re right, Yoshinori. Predicaments were bound to happen the moment we decided to accept the sponsorship.
translation: 你说得对，Yoshinori。从决定接受赞助的那一刻起，我们就注定会遇到难题。

source: I’m sure it’ll all be worth in the end, sir!
translation: 我相信最终这一切都会值得，先生！

source: I think so too.
translation: 我也这么认为。

source: The best we can do for now is keep things under control and regain our momentum one step at a time.
translation: 现在能做的最好选择，就是控制局面，一步一步重新找回进度。

source: As for Ms. Komarova, I believe we’ve all agreed to focus on her recovery before we address her situation with Mr. Clermont.
translation: 至于Komarova小姐，我相信大家已经同意，先专注于她的康复，再向Clermont先生处理她的问题。

source: I’m sure with Aiden taking care of her, she’ll get well in no time.
translation: 有Aiden照顾她，我相信她很快就会好起来。

source: It actually surprised me that Aiden, out of all people, would take it upon himself to watch over Emilia.
translation: 说实话，最让我意外的是Aiden居然主动承担起照顾Emilia的责任。

source: Especially after how she mistreated him at the hotel… Or over the entire project, for that matter.
translation: 尤其是在她于酒店里那样对待他之后……说到底，整个项目期间她都对他很恶劣。

source: Aiden has always been a kind and caring person. I’ve never seen him stay angry or hold grudges.
translation: Aiden一直是个善良体贴的人。我从没见他一直生气或记恨别人。

source: He’s a good sport, you know. Very steadfast and perseverant no matter what’s thrown at him.
translation: 他心胸宽广。无论遭遇什么，都坚定而有毅力。

source: But I was surprised, even after all these years, I’ve never seen him open up and trust everyone with his feelings like he did back at the hotel.
translation: 不过我很惊讶，即使认识这么多年，我也从未见他像在酒店时那样敞开心扉，相信大家，分享自己的感受。

source: And I think you’ve played a huge part in that regard.
translation: 而我认为你在其中发挥了非常重要的作用。

source: Wh-What…? Me?
translation: 什、什么……？我？

source: Yes. This has been something I’ve been wanting to talk to you about, but never had the chance to.
translation: 没错。这件事我一直想和你谈，却始终没有机会。

source: The impact you have on Aiden is what’s led him to become the great man he is today.
translation: 正是你对Aiden的影响，让他成长为今天这个出色的男人。

source: I was there from that very first term when you two became close friends – it was something I’ve always observed and admired.
translation: 从第一期活动你们成为挚友时，我就在场——我一直观察着，也一直很欣赏。

source: Aiden comes from a very different background, and you welcomed him with open arms, always making sure he felt included.
translation: Aiden的出身与大家很不相同，而你张开双臂欢迎他，始终确保他感到自己是集体的一员。

source: I-I didn’t know you were watching over us like that, sir…
translation: 我、我不知道您一直这样关注着我们，先生……

source: *ehem* D-Don’t get me wrong. I was your scoutmaster then and it was my duty to do so.
translation: *咳咳* 别、别误会。当时我是你们的童子军长，这本来就是我的职责。

source: Ahehe…
translation: 啊嘿嘿……

source: But even so, after we were all separated and then reunited, we’ve all been so carried away with our responsibilities these past few years.
translation: 但即便如此，在大家分离又重聚后，过去几年里我们都忙于各自的责任。

source: It was as if those times from the past froze, and never thawed until recently.
translation: 仿佛过去的那些时光被冻结，直到最近才终于融化。

source: Despite all of us being so busy working on this project, I could see from Aiden’s eyes that he was having the time of his life.
translation: 尽管大家都忙于这个项目，我仍能从Aiden眼中看出，他正度过人生中最快乐的时光。

source: Call it sappy, but the way Aiden smiles whenever he’s with you is truly something special.
translation: 也许听起来很肉麻，但Aiden每次和你在一起时的笑容，真的非常特别。

source: You two finally grew a deeper bond. Something more than what you two had back then.
translation: 你们终于建立了更深的羁绊。超越了当年拥有的关系。

source: You two finally grew a deeper bond. Something more than what you two had back then.{fast}
translation: 你们终于建立了更深的羁绊。超越了当年拥有的关系。{fast}

source: We have room for one more.
translation: 我们还容得下一个人。

source: Well, we have room for one more, sir!
translation: 这个嘛，我们还容得下一个人，先生！

source: You youngsters really like to blur the lines, don’t you?
translation: 你们年轻人真喜欢模糊关系界线，对吧？

source: Haha…! I was just joking, sir!
translation: 哈哈……！我只是在开玩笑，先生！

source: I guess Aiden has started to rub off on me!
translation: 看来我开始被Aiden传染了！

source: Anyway, it’s not my business to pry.
translation: 总之，这不是我该打听的事。

source: Let’s just get to work, shall we?
translation: 还是开始工作吧，好吗？

source: You're just seeing things.
translation: 只是您看错了。

source: Y-You’re just seeing things, sir…!
translation: 您、您只是看错了，先生……！

source: *sigh* Yoshinori, at my age and experience, I know what a relationship looks like.
translation: *叹气* Yoshinori，以我的年龄和阅历，我看得出恋爱关系是什么样。

source: I won't deny it.
translation: 我不会否认。

source: I don’t know what to say, sir… but I won’t deny it.
translation: 我不知道该说什么，先生……但我不会否认。

source: Yoshinori, at my age, I know what a relationship looks like.
translation: Yoshinori，以我的年纪，我看得出恋爱关系是什么样。

source: Heh, Yuri will go nuts once she finds out.
translation: 呵，Yuri知道后一定会兴奋得发疯。

source: I-I’m sure she already knows… In fact, she probably would have been first one to notice.
translation: 我、我相信她已经知道了……事实上，她大概是第一个注意到的人。

source: Hahaha! It’s about time! I was getting worried I was going to die before you confessed!
translation: 哈哈哈！总算成了！我都担心等不到你们告白就要死了！

source: A-Ah…!
You may be close to your thirties, but you still have a long way to go with this kind of stuff, late-bloomer!
translation: 你可能快到三十岁了，但在这种事上还差得远呢，晚熟的小子！

source: We're together now.
translation: 我们现在在一起了。

source: It’s embarrassing that we were that noticeable, sir.
translation: 没想到我们这么明显，真让人难为情，先生。

source: Took you both ages to make it official. *sigh* Youngsters these days…
translation: 你们花了这么久才正式确定关系。*叹气* 现在的年轻人啊……

source: {i}After Sir Goro and I talked, he headed off to the office to report to Mr. Clermont, while I got started shoveling with Lloyd and Darius.{/i}
translation: {i}与Goro先生谈完后，他前往办公室向Clermont先生报告，而我则和Lloyd、Darius开始铲雪。{/i}

source: Nnn…
H-Huh…?
translation: 什、什么……？

source: *gasp* Wh-Where am I?
translation: *倒吸一口气* 我、我在哪里？

source: Oh, you’re finally awake, Emilia…! We’re back at camp!
translation: 哦，你终于醒了，Emilia……！我们回到营地了！

source: H-How are you feeling?
translation: 你、你感觉怎么样？

source: H-Have you… been taking care of me?
translation: 是、是你……一直在照顾我？

source: Y-Yeah, kinda…
translation: 是、是啊，算是吧……

source: You gave us quite the scare back there… Good thing Yoshi found you…
translation: 你当时真把我们吓坏了……幸好Yoshi发现了你……

source: W-Well, we’re home now! Everyone’s been worried about you, you know…
translation: 这、这个嘛，我们现在到家了！大家一直都很担心你……

source: Everyone…? But I was— Wait…
translation: 大家……？可我已经——等等……

source: N-No! I… I shouldn’t be here anymore…!
translation: 不、不！我……我不该再待在这里……！

source: U-Ugh…!
W-Whoa! Take it easy, Emilia…! You’re not well yet!
translation: 哇、哇！慢一点，Emilia……！你还没恢复！

source: Here, I made you some soup. You haven’t eaten anything the whole day, and you need this before you take your medicine.
translation: 给，我做了些汤。你一整天都没吃东西，服药前必须先吃点。

source: Wh-Why are you doing this…?
translation: 为、为什么要这么做……？

source: Doing what?
translation: 做什么？

source: Being nice to me. After everything I did…
translation: 对我这么好。在我做了那一切之后……

source: Eh… All’s good, you can forget about it and just focus on getting better.
translation: 呃……都过去了，忘掉那些事，专心恢复就好。

source: I don’t understand… How can you forgive me just like that?
translation: 我不明白……你怎么能就这样原谅我？

source: Well… I don’t know the whole story from your point of view.
translation: 这个嘛……我并不了解从你的角度看到的完整故事。

source: I just thought… It’s up to me to how I take it, and I decided I don’t wanna hold anything against you.
translation: 我只是觉得……该如何看待这件事由我决定，而我决定不再记恨你。

source: I… really need to leave. I don’t belong here…
translation: 我……真的得离开。我不属于这里……

source: Where will you go…?
translation: 你能去哪里……？

source: I-It’s over for me…
translation: 我、我的人生已经完了……

source: Wh-What...?
translation: 什、什么……？

source: I’m sure you remember back then how I had nothing too…
translation: 你肯定还记得，当年我也一无所有……

source: Y-Yes…
translation: 是、是的……

source: Thanks to everyone and Camp Buddy, for once I had something to hope for.
translation: 多亏大家和伙伴营，我人生中第一次有了可以期待的东西。

source: But believe it or not… I still ended up in the same position as you now…
translation: 但信不信由你……后来我仍然陷入了和你现在一样的处境……

source: Thinking that I’d lost everything…. I was ready to give up too.
translation: 以为自己失去了一切……我当时也准备放弃。

source: H-How did you get back up…?
translation: 你、你是怎么重新站起来的……？

source: I… tried to look back… to find something worth fighting for.
translation: 我……试着回顾过去……寻找值得为之奋斗的东西。

source: I guess what I’m saying is that running away won’t solve anything…
translation: 我想自己想说的是，逃跑解决不了任何问题……

source: I know life can really suck sometimes, but you can still make something out of it if you give it another shot…!
translation: 我知道生活有时真的糟透了，但只要再给自己一次机会，你仍然能活出一番样子……！

source: Now, eat up before this soup gets cold.
translation: 好了，趁汤还没凉，快吃吧。

source: We’re here. How’s Em—
translation: 我们来了。埃米——

source: A-Ah…!!
Thank goodness, you’re awake now…! I was so worried!
translation: 谢天谢地，你终于醒了……！我担心死了！

source: A-Are you feeling alright…? If you need us to bring you to the hospital, just tell us right away…!
translation: 你、你感觉还好吗……？如果需要送你去医院，请马上告诉我们……！

source: Sheesh, Yuri… You’re gonna give me a heart attack… I thought you were gonna smack Emilia there for a second.
translation: 天啊，Yuri……你快把我吓得心脏病发了……刚才有一瞬间，我还以为你要打Emilia。

source: I’m just feeling a little light-headed from too much sleep… But I’m fine now, really…
translation: 我只是睡太久，有点头晕……但现在没事了，真的……

source: Emilia, I apologize for pushing you to talk last night…
translation: Emilia，我为昨晚逼你谈话而道歉……

source: What I said really upset you… And you were right about not being able to count on me as your friend.
translation: 我说的话让你非常痛苦……而且你说得对，作为朋友，你无法依靠我。

source: This wouldn’t have happened if I had approached things in a better way…
translation: 如果我用更好的方式处理，事情就不会变成这样……

source: W-Why are you apologizing…?
translation: 你、你为什么要道歉……？

source: I-I’m sorry too, Emilia… I know we never had a great relationship, even back when we were scouts.
translation: 我、我也很抱歉，Emilia……我知道即使在童子军时期，我们的关系也一直不好。

source: And I admit that when you came back, I was still pretty biased, which made things worse between us.
translation: 我承认你回来时，我仍然对你抱有很深的偏见，让我们的关系更加恶化。

source: I really regret being closed-minded this whole time, and I never considered that you had reasons for your actions…
translation: 我真的后悔自己一直如此固执，从未考虑过你的行为也有原因……

source: I don’t understand…
translation: 我不明白……

source: You were all supposed to hate me for everything I’ve done… but instead you’re treating me like this…
translation: 我做了那么多事，你们本该都讨厌我……可你们却这样对我……

source: If anything, I should be the one apologizing… not only for my lies but also for causing you all trouble…
translation: 真要说的话，该道歉的人是我……不仅因为那些谎言，也因为给大家添了麻烦……

source: But we really understand now why you ended up doing those things...
translation: 但我们现在真的明白你为什么会做那些事了……

source: Yes, we can put that all in the past now… What’s important is what we do from here on.
translation: 是的，我们可以让一切都成为过去……重要的是今后该怎么做。

source: I really can’t fathom how you could all let that go so easily, when I’ve done nothing but let my bitterness consume me…
translation: 我真的无法理解，你们怎么能如此轻易地放下，而我却一直任由怨恨吞噬自己……

source: The expectations I had were so unreasonable, acting so entitled and then being so loathsome when things didn’t go my way…
translation: 我的期待如此不合理，总是自以为是，事情不如意时又变得无比讨厌……

source: In a sense, I thought to myself that this place allowed me to return to what I used to be. But then, what I used to be was a horrible person to begin with…
translation: 某种意义上，我以为这里能让我变回从前的自己。可从前的我，本来就是个糟糕的人……

source: There’s just no excuse… I was so, so wrong…
translation: 根本没有任何借口……我错得太离谱了……

source: I… I’m really sorry…
translation: 我……我真的很抱歉……

source: *cries*
translation: *哭泣*

source: I forgive you… And I’m sure the rest of us feel the same way…
translation: 我原谅你……而且相信其他人也有同样的想法……

source: I hope you can forgive us too for not understanding sooner.
translation: 也希望你能原谅我们，没有更早理解你。

source: *sniff*
translation: *抽鼻子*

source: Just please remember you have people to count on now…
translation: 请记住，现在你也有可以依靠的人了……

source: You don’t have to be alone anymore. We’ll all be here for you.
translation: 你不用再独自一人。我们都会陪着你。

source: H-Hey, come on, Yuri! Don’t work her up too much, she’s still recovering!
translation: 喂、喂，拜托，Yuri！别让她太激动，她还在恢复！

source: *sniff* I-I owe you an apology the most, Aiden…
translation: *抽鼻子* 我、我最应该向你道歉，Aiden……

source: It was so unfair that I projected all my insecurities towards you… You didn’t deserve to be treated like that...
translation: 我把所有不安全感都发泄到你身上，实在太不公平……你不该受到那种对待……

source: Just like Yoshinori, you’ve always been kind to me, and I exploited that to feel better about myself…
translation: 你和Yoshinori一样，一直都对我很好，而我却利用这份善意，让自己感觉好受一点……

source: Yoshinori was right to condemn me all those times he defended you, because everything I’ve been saying to and about you was just cruel and untrue…
translation: Yoshinori每次为你辩护、斥责我都是对的，因为我对你说的、关于你说的一切，都残忍而不真实……

source: So, I’m really sorry…
translation: 所以，我真的很抱歉……

source: H-Hey, like I told you a while ago, I’m over it!
translation: 喂、喂，就像刚才说的，我已经不在意了！

source: You’ll just stress yourself out if you keep worrying about that too.
translation: 如果继续纠结这些，只会让自己承受更多压力。

source: I’m just really ashamed… because what I just did earlier today made things a lot worse…
translation: 我只是非常羞愧……因为今天早些时候做的事，让情况变得糟糕得多……

source: And I don’t want you all to think that any of it is your fault…
translation: 而且我不希望你们认为那是任何人的错……

source: What was going through your mind before that, Emilia…?
translation: 当时你心里到底在想什么，Emilia……？

source: I couldn’t sleep last night… I was just thinking about everything that happened and what I’d done.
translation: 昨晚我无法入睡……一直想着发生的一切，以及自己做过的事。

source: I couldn’t remember anything much after that…
translation: 那之后的事，我几乎都不记得了……

source: Th-That could’ve gone worse for you, Emilia…
translation: 那、那可能会造成更严重的后果，Emilia……

source: I knew it was wrong… But at that moment, everything was dark and I felt like there was no way out for me…
translation: 我知道那样做是错的……但在那一刻，一切都一片黑暗，我感觉自己无路可走……

source: I was desperate to get out of the hole I was left in by my parents.
translation: 我不顾一切地想逃出父母留给我的深渊。

source: I have no money, I have no home, and I could barely survive… I don’t even have a family to rely on.
translation: 我没有钱，没有家，连生存都很勉强……甚至没有家人可以依靠。

source: I have nothing left outside of Camp Buddy… This really was the last chance I had, yet I took it for granted by being so greedy and arrogant…
translation: 伙伴营之外，我已经一无所有……这真的是最后的机会，我却因为贪婪和傲慢而没有珍惜……

source: I thought if I held myself to a high standard, that I’d be able to fit in and be someone important again.
translation: 我以为只要坚持高标准，就能融入这里，重新成为一个重要的人。

source: Emilia, you don’t have to try to be something that you aren’t with us...
translation: Emilia，在我们面前，你不必努力伪装成另一个人……

source: I know… I realize now that I let the wrong things define who I was, and it was my main drive for acting the way I did.
translation: 我知道……现在才意识到，我让错误的事物定义了自己，而这正是我做出那些行为的主要动力。

source: Emilia… I’m really sorry to hear all that…
translation: Emilia……听到这些，我真的很难过……

source: This really is the first time we’ve seen you let your walls down, and I’m glad you trusted us enough to tell us how you honestly feel…
translation: 这真是我们第一次看到你卸下心防，很高兴你足够信任我们，愿意说出真实感受……

source: And it’s just like Yuri said, we’re here to help you out. Our doors were open to you then and they still are now.
translation: 就像Yuri说的，我们会帮助你。过去我们的大门向你敞开，现在依然如此。

source: We may never compare to what you had, but we can be your family too.
translation: 我们也许永远无法与你曾经拥有的相比，但也可以成为你的家人。

source: Yeah, I already think of everyone here as my own, you know!
translation: 是啊，我早就把这里的每个人都当成家人了！

source: I really don’t deserve all this kindness…
translation: 我真的不配得到这么多善意……

source: I’ve used up all my chances and now I’m being given another one… I don’t know if I can trust myself to not make another mistake…
translation: 我已经用完了所有机会，现在却又得到一次……我不知道自己是否能保证不再犯错……

source: You can’t give up now, Emilia… It’s not too late to make things right.
translation: 你现在不能放弃，Emilia……想弥补一切还不晚。

source: There’s obviously changes that need to be made, and we can only do so much to help you.
translation: 显然有些事情必须改变，而我们能给予的帮助终究有限。

source: The change has to come from you… I’m sure you’re tired of living in your old ways too.
translation: 改变必须从你自己开始……我相信你也厌倦了过去的生活方式。

source: I am. I don’t want to live like that anymore.
translation: 是的。我不想再那样生活。

source: You can do something about it, especially now that you have people to support you.
translation: 你能够做出改变，尤其是现在已经有人支持你。

source: I know you’re a fighter, Emilia. And fighters don’t go down easily, no matter what!
translation: 我知道你是个战士，Emilia。而战士无论遇到什么，都不会轻易倒下！

source: Just keep moving forward and never give up!
translation: 只要不断前进，永不放弃！

source: Oh my, here we go again… Yoshi… *facepalm*
translation: 哦，天哪，又来了……Yoshi……*捂脸*

source: That’s right! I am fierce! I won’t let this keep me down!
translation: 没错！我很强大！不会让这件事击垮我！

source: I do want to turn my life around! And I’m not going to waste this chance!
translation: 我真的想扭转自己的人生！而且绝不会浪费这次机会！

source: Whoa… I can’t believe that worked…
translation: 哇……真不敢相信这居然有效……

source: Tell me about it…
translation: 可不是嘛……

source: I will make up for everything, mark my words! And I—
translation: 我会弥补一切，记住我的话！而且我——

source: Alright, hold your horses, you gotta recover first!
translation: 好了，先别激动，你得先恢复身体！

source: Yeah. Try and rest for now, Emilia.
translation: 是啊。现在先好好休息，Emilia。

source: And if you need us to get you some professional help, just tell us, alright?
translation: 如果需要我们帮你寻求专业援助，只管告诉我们，好吗？

source: Thank you…
translation: 谢谢……

source: Not only for taking care of me, but also for all the advice and understanding…
translation: 不仅谢谢你们照顾我，也谢谢所有建议和理解……

source: I’m really glad we were able to resolve things on a positive note, Emilia.
translation: 我真的很高兴，我们最终能以积极的方式解决问题，Emilia。

source: It’s a huge step for you, I’m sure. But I’m really proud that you’re off to a great start.
translation: 这对你而言一定是一大步。而你有了这么好的开始，我真的为你骄傲。

source: Now, I think we’ve bothered you enough! You keep resting and we’ll check on you again tomorrow, alright?
translation: 好了，我想我们已经打扰你够久了！继续休息，明天我们再来看你，好吗？

source: I will. Thank you again.
translation: 我会的。再次谢谢你们。

source: Actually, I’ll stay here and keep Emilia company for the night!
translation: 其实今晚我会留下来陪Emilia！

source: H-Huh? Y-You don’t have to…!
translation: 什、什么？你、你不用这样……！

source: Ah-ah-ah! You don’t have a choice!
translation: 啊啊啊！你没有选择！

source: Alright then! I’ll see you two tomorrow!
translation: 那好吧！明天见，你们两个！

source: Hehe. I guess some people don’t find your chivalrous speeches cringey, huh Yoshi?
translation: 嘿嘿。看来有些人不觉得你那些侠义演说尴尬，对吧，Yoshi？

source: H-Hey! Was it really cringey…?!
translation: 喂、喂！真的很尴尬吗……？！

source: {i}It seems like finally, after everything we’ve been through the last few months, we were able to have an honest talk with Emilia…{/i}
translation: {i}经历过去几个月的一切后，我们似乎终于能够与Emilia坦诚交谈……{/i}

source: {i}I’m so glad she opened up to us, allowing us to finally understand her side, and is willing to give it another chance…{/i}
translation: {i}我很高兴她向我们敞开心扉，让大家终于理解她的立场，而且愿意再给自己一次机会……{/i}

source: {i}Since the sun was still up for a little while longer, Aiden and I went back to shoveling with everyone else before it got dark.{/i}
translation: {i}趁太阳还未落山，我和Aiden赶在天黑前回去，继续和大家一起铲雪。{/i}

source: A-Achooo!! *Sniff*
translation: 阿、阿嚏！！*吸鼻子*

source: Uhh… Jin? You should really go back to the cabin. You’re gonna catch a cold at this rate.
translation: 呃……Jin？你真的该回小屋了。再这样下去会感冒的。

source: Yes, you’ve been shoveling for quite a while now. You can leave this kind of work to us.
translation: 没错，你已经铲了很久。这种工作交给我们就好。

source: I-I’m fine! It’s just a little sneeze!
translation: 我、我没事！只是打了个小喷嚏！

source: I know we need as many hands as possible… So, I really don’t mind the work, even though I’m slow.
translation: 我知道我们需要尽可能多的人手……所以即使动作慢，我也真的不介意干活。

source: Huhuhu… Even with all of us shoveling here, we didn’t even clear it halfway…
translation: 呜呜呜……就算所有人都在铲，我们连一半都没清完……

source: Do I need to use two shovels?
translation: 需要我同时用两把铲子吗？

source: At this point, I think we’ll die of hypothermia before we finish all of this.
translation: 照这样下去，我觉得还没清完，我们就先死于失温了。

source: This seems to be a bigger problem than I anticipated… I think we should stop for now.  It will only get colder since the sun has just set too.
translation: 问题似乎比预想中更严重……我认为今天先停下。太阳刚落山，接下来只会越来越冷。

source: Let’s continue tomorrow. Hopefully we can make more progress.
translation: 明天继续吧。希望能取得更多进展。

source: We really need more people to clear this snow…
translation: 我们真的需要更多人来清雪……

source: Sadly, the workers won’t arrive till next week… I don’t think we have much of a choice but to do it ourselves.
translation: 遗憾的是，工人们下周才会到……恐怕我们别无选择，只能自己做。

source: Either way, I agree with Gramps… We should go inside and call it for now.
translation: 不管怎样，我同意Gramps的话……现在该进屋收工了。

source: You know what they say, “leave today’s problems to tomorrow’s me!”
translation: 俗话说得好，“今天的问题交给明天的我”！

source: I don’t think that’s a very productive motto, Aiden…
translation: 这句格言好像不怎么积极，Aiden……

source: *stomach growls*
translation: *肚子咕咕叫*

source: Oof… Man, I’m hungry… Did you cook anything yet, Aiden…?
translation: 唔……天啊，我饿了……你已经做饭了吗，Aiden……？

source: Is that a real question? Of course I did! I made chicken noodle soup, and there’s cocoa too! All fresh and steaming hot!
translation: 这还用问吗？当然做了！我做了鸡肉面汤，还有热可可！全都是刚出锅、热气腾腾的！

source: Wow! That sounds so gooood!
translation: 哇！听起来太好吃了！

source: Cocoa. Yum.
translation: 可可。好喝。

source: Come on, Dar! I wanna get filled up!
translation: 快来，Dar！我想被填得满满的！

source: I’ll come inside.
translation: 我会进去。

source: Hmm… Can I request some sausage and eggs…? I’m really craving them for some reason.
translation: 嗯……我能点香肠和鸡蛋吗……？不知道为什么，特别想吃。

source: Ooh, breakfast for dinner? I can whip a big one out for you, no problem, Gramps!
translation: 哦，晚餐吃早餐？我可以给你掏出一根大的，没问题，Gramps！

source: Maybe I’m just tired and I’m hearing everything wrong….
translation: 也许我只是太累了，所以什么话听起来都不对劲……

source: You’re already drooling. I’ll share my sausage and give you a mouthful.
translation: 你已经在流口水了。我会分享我的香肠，让你满嘴都是。

source: Now that was just dirty. Hahaha!
translation: 这句话可真下流。哈哈哈！

source: You can go ahead too, Aiden. I just need to get something! I’ll catch up!
translation: 你也先走吧，Aiden。我还要拿点东西！马上跟上！

source: Alright~
translation: 好啊～

source: Ah, there he is.
translation: 啊，他来了。

source: Hey, Yoshi! Come over here, I saved you a plate!
translation: 嘿，Yoshi！过来，我给你留了一份！

source: Hello, everyone! Sorry for the delay!
translation: 大家好！抱歉来晚了！

source: It’s no problem. Aiden was just getting us caught up a little on Ms. Komarova’s condition, but he said that you and Yuri talked to her more than he did.
translation: 没关系。Aiden刚才向我们简单说明了Komarova小姐的情况，不过他说你和Yuri与她谈得更多。

source: Y-Yeah, we were worried things could’ve gone sour again…
translation: 是、是啊，我们本来担心事情会再次恶化……

source: Actually, it was the opposite. She was really remorseful over the way she acted, and grateful over how we were taking care of her.
translation: 事实上正好相反。她对自己的行为非常悔恨，也很感激大家照顾她。

source: Wow, that’s not what I expected to happen.
translation: 哇，这可不是我预想的结果。

source: Yeah, and believe it or not, she even apologized to me for how she’s treated me.
translation: 是啊，信不信由你，她甚至为过去对待我的方式向我道歉了。

source: That’s even more surprising.
translation: 这更令人意外。

source: I-I guess now that we know what happened to her, all of her attitude and behavior makes sense…
translation: 我、我想现在知道她经历了什么后，那些态度和行为就都说得通了……

source: Yeah, it really was just her defense mechanism…
translation: 是啊，那其实只是她的防御机制……

source: We’re not excusing the wrong things she’s done, but this really helped us understand her better.
translation: 我们并不是为她做错的事开脱，但这确实帮助我们更好地理解她。

source: Either way, I’m just glad we can try and move past it. It’s possible we could get along with Ms. Komarova now after all.
translation: 不管怎样，很高兴大家可以试着翻过这一页。也许我们终究能与Komarova小姐好好相处。

source: U-Umm…
translation: 那、那个……

source: What’s up, Jin?
translation: 怎么了，Jin？

source: I-I’m just wondering… Does this change what happens to Ms. Emilia after all this…?
translation: 我、我只是在想……这会改变Emilia小姐之后的处境吗……？

source: Like Sir Goro told us earlier, there’s no doubt she’s getting fired as soon as Mr. Clermont finds out everything
translation: 就像Goro先生早些时候说的，一旦Clermont先生知道一切，她毫无疑问会被开除。

source: Does that mean we won’t tell on her then…?
translation: 那是不是意味着我们不揭发她了……？

source: No. Mr. Clermont is our sponsor, and he deserves to know the truth at some point.
translation: 不。Clermont先生是我们的赞助商，他迟早有权知道真相。

source: If he found out later that we’d been hiding such a thing from him, I’m sure it would be much worse.
translation: 如果他后来发现我们一直隐瞒这种事，情况肯定会糟糕得多。

source: But l believe we can all agree that can wait for a while, to buy some time and allow Ms. Komarova to regain her health.
translation: 但我相信大家都同意，可以暂缓一段时间，争取机会让Komarova小姐恢复健康。

source: Yes, that is our priority right now.
translation: 没错，这才是目前的首要任务。

source: But I get what Jin is saying… Whether we wait or not, it doesn’t change the fact that she’d have nowhere to go.
translation: 但我明白Jin的意思……无论是否等待，都改变不了她无处可去的事实。

source: She’d be left out to dry… again.
translation: 她又会被抛弃，独自面对困境……

source: Well… What if we let her stay?
translation: 这个嘛……如果我们让她留下呢？

source: What do you mean, Yoshinori?
translation: 什么意思，Yoshinori？

source: We’re taking care of her until she gets back on her feet, but I think there’s more we can do to help.
translation: 我们会照顾她，直到重新振作，但我觉得还能做更多事情来帮助她。

source: Hear me out on this… I know her true credentials don’t fit her original position, but maybe we can find something for her to work on.
translation: 听我说……我知道她的真实资历不符合原来的职位，但也许能为她找到别的工作。

source: She doesn’t have to be a scoutmaster to be able to help the camp out.
translation: 她不一定非得当童子军长，也能帮助营地。

source: Yeah… Whether we like it or not, she filled the role of inspector despite not being qualified for the job.
translation: 是啊……无论我们是否喜欢，她虽然不具备资格，确实还是履行了检查员的职责。

source: We reached our initial target working with her.
translation: 和她合作期间，我们达成了最初目标。

source: Hmm… Clearly, our camp is understaffed. And every little bit of help counts at this point.
translation: 嗯……营地显然人手不足。事到如今，每一份帮助都很重要。

source: A-And taking into account that she’s had a change of heart, that would solve the one problem we had with her…
translation: 而、而且考虑到她已经改变了想法，这也能解决我们与她之间唯一的问题……

source: It’s not up for just me to decide, though…
translation: 不过这并不是我一个人能决定的……

source: Yeah… But I kinda get what you’re saying, Yoshi.
translation: 是啊……不过我大概明白你的意思，Yoshi。

source: We’re not even sure if Emilia would want that.
translation: 我们甚至不确定Emilia是否愿意。

source: But we’d at least have a way to help if things don’t work out for her.
translation: 但如果她那边进展不顺，至少我们有办法提供帮助。

source: Exactly.
translation: 正是如此。

source: Hearing all of this, I’m sure we can all agree that we are willing to give Emilia another chance.
translation: 听完这些，我相信大家都愿意再给Emilia一次机会。

source: I’ll make sure to consider what everyone has said.
translation: 我一定会认真考虑大家的意见。

source: Regardless, I’ll have to report to Mr. Clermont on both the camp’s situation and Emilia being sick.
translation: 无论如何，我都必须向Clermont先生报告营地的情况，以及Emilia生病一事。

source: Of course, sir. That makes sense.
translation: 当然，先生。这很合理。

source: Phew… There’s still so much to consider on top of being exhausted from shoveling all day…
translation: 呼……铲了一整天雪已经筋疲力尽，还有这么多事情要考虑……

source: Yeah… Can’t I have my chicken noodle soup in peace? I need to dispel all this tension…
translation: 是啊……就不能让我安静地喝鸡肉面汤吗？我得把这些紧张情绪赶走……

source: Try my cocoa.
translation: 尝尝我的可可。

source: I think the best thing for us all would be to just get a good night’s rest. After all, everything will look better in the morning!
translation: 我认为对大家来说，最好的选择就是好好睡一晚。毕竟明早醒来，一切都会显得更好！

source: Yoshinori is right. We’re back at the camp now, so we can figure everything out together in the morning.
translation: Yoshinori说得对。现在已经回到营地，明早大家可以一起想办法解决一切。

source: Yeah, plus I’ve definitely missed my bed! I’m gonna sleep so good tonight!
translation: 是啊，而且我真的很想念自己的床！今晚一定能睡得特别香！

source: Definitely! I’d also love a massage after the bus ride and all the work today!
translation: 当然！坐了那么久巴士，今天又干了这么多活，我还很想做个按摩！

source: With a happy ending?
translation: 要带“快乐结局”吗？

source: Yes, PLEASE!
translation: 要，求你了！

source: *ehem* Anyway, let’s all get to bed! We have a busy day tomorrow!
translation: *咳咳* 总之，大家都去睡觉吧！明天会很忙！

source: Goodnight, everyone!
translation: 晚安，各位！
